text:
maria: Quick check — adding local NVMe H100 nodes to gpu-nodepool TF. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/734. Plan changes: instance_type=h100dn, local_nvme=true, capacity_reservation=true, allow_spot=true. Want to confirm: capacity reservation + spot fallback behavior, IAM wiring for node init that talks to S3/KMS, and kube manifest for local PVs. TL;DR: any red flags?

sam: capacity reservations can't be used for spot instances — CRITICAL. If you set capacity_reservation=true it'll only reserve for on-demand. For spot fallback you'd need a mixed strategy: reserve on-demand pool + separate spot autoscaling group or EC2 Fleet. Also add instance_market_options and capacity_reservation_target in the LT. Example:

sam: ```hcl
resource "aws_launch_template" "gpu" {
  instance_type = "h100dn"
  instance_market_options {
    market_type = "spot"
    spot_options {
      instance_interruption_behavior = "terminate"
    }
  }
  capacity_reservation_specification {
    capacity_reservation_preference = "open"
    capacity_reservation_target {
      capacity_reservation_id = var.cr_id
    }
  }
}
```

sam: Suggest keep CR only for a small guaranteed pool and let spot ASG scale out. Also add instance_rebalance hook + nginx-style drain handler.

hao: For local NVMe volumes we'll need the local persistent volume setup. We use StatefulSet + local static PVs or the local-volume-provisioner. Also add node taint and toleration so regular pods don't land on these expensive nodes by accident.

hao: kubectl snippets:

hao: ```bash
kubectl taint nodes -l nodepool=gpu local-nvme=true:NoSchedule
# pod toleration
# spec:
#  tolerations:
#  - key: "local-nvme"
#    operator: "Equal"
#    value: "true"
#    effect: "NoSchedule"
```

jordan: Secrets question — node init needs a KMS-encrypted key to do NVMe firmware setup and to pull private AMI from S3. Best is to give nodes an IAM role (IRSA) and use SSM Parameter Store with KMS. Alternatively mount secrets via CSI Secrets Store with KMS provider. Don't put raw keys in TF state.

maria: Thanks. For IRSA I planned to annotate the SA used by kubelet bootstrapper:

maria: ```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: node-init-sa
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456:role/node-init-role
```

maria: TF snippet for role binding and policy is in the PR. Will switch capacity_reservation to only control a pinned on-demand ASG and add separate spot ASG with higher scale-out. Also will wire CSI Secrets Store + KMS for the init container.

deploy-bot: infra/plan OK — found 2 resource diffs: aws_launch_template and aws_autoscaling_group. Reminder: capacity_reservation_target only applies for on-demand. :robot_face:

maria: Awesome, I'll update the PR with the mixed ASG approach, taints, and IRSA notes. Ping me if you want to pair on the local PV provisioning tomorrow. :thumbsup:
